description:
Dani Kang sometimes wonders what her life would have been like if she had run away on her wedding day. She was a successful career woman before getting married, but now she is divorced, unemployed, and a single mother of one. During her divorce, her life got turned upside down as she found herself not only struggling to re-enter the professional world after having taken a long break from it but in desperate need of a home as well. When her dear friend, Eunho Cha, who is a successful author and a chief editor at a publishing company, asks Dani to help him find a housekeeper, she decides to take up that job herself without his knowledge. Eventually, she gets discovered and receives help from Eunho, but then their lives become even more intertwined when Dani applies for an open position at his company. Will they be able to navigate through all the personal and professional challenges lying ahead of them? 

(Source: Tappytoon)
